decision: Selected the centroid of Maricopa County Assessor parcel 304-34-015G (owner of record Amazon Data Services Inc), the parcel that contains the City of Mesa permit geocode for 10464 E Pecos Rd, the address of the AWS PHX065 permits and of both inspected data-center building permits, as the campus locator.

selected_properties.spatial_reference: outSR=4326 (WGS84) as returned by the assessor's ArcGIS MapServer

computed.method: Single-ring polygon returned by the assessor service in WGS84; centroid computed in EPSG:32612 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 12N) and returned to WGS84; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid

identity_bridge: City of Mesa Building Permits (dzpk-hxfb): the permits at 10464 E PECOS RD are titled 'AWS PHX065 - FINAL PLAT', 'AWS PHX065 - At-Risk Grading', 'AWS PHX065 Bldg 2' (site improvements for the new data center building PMT24-15709), 'TEMP CONSTRUCTION TRAILER - AWS PHX065 BLDG 2', 'AWS PHX065 - Offsite Fire Hydrant', 'AWS PHX065 - Parking Canopies' and 'PHX065' (data center temporary power plan); the two 229,416 sq ft single-storey data-center building permits PMT24-15709 ('Data Center Bldg 2') and PMT25-13554 ('Data Center Bldg B') are at the same address and cross-reference each other.
Every permit row at 10464 E PECOS RD carries the same city geocode (-111.608238, 33.292278); a point-in-polygon query of the assessor parcel layer at that geocode returns only parcel 304-34-015G.

The assessor layer names AMAZON DATA SERVICES INC (Seattle, WA mailing address) as owner of 304-34-015G (deed 20250417207, 21 July 2025). An owner query for 'AMAZON DATA%' within Mesa returns only 304-34-015G and 314-10-777 (10437 E Elliot Rd, the separate PHX066 site about 5.7 km north).

Permits issued before the July 2025 deed cite parcel 30434015E, which the current assessor layer no longer returns; permits from mid-2026 (PMT26-07770, PMT26-13074) cite 30434015G, consistent with a re-plat under 'AWS PHX065 - FINAL PLAT'.
unresolved: The parcel has no situs address in the assessor layer; the link to 10464 E Pecos Rd rests on the city's permit geocode falling inside the parcel and on the permit parcel references, not on an address match.
The positions of Building 2 and Building B within the 70-acre parcel are not published; the centroid locates the campus property, not either building.

Two permit titles are cross-filed: 'AWS PHX066 - Parking Canopies' (PMT26-07174) is filed at 10464 E Pecos Rd and 'PHX 065' (PMT26-13246, an ERRC permit) at 10437 E Elliot Rd, so the PHX066 designation of the Elliot Road parcel is inferred.
